lines.zh: 我贴着树线飞，旋翼声很闷。
lines.en: I fly along the treeline, rotors thudding.
I sweep low over the roofs.
I head for that open ground on the edge of town.
I drop low to see the ground.
I circle the block once.
I hover and ease forward.

lines.zh: 我调整了航向，避开电线。
lines.en: I correct course to miss the wires.
I follow the main road over.
I fly close to the wall in case I am spotted.
I head for the smoke.
I step my altitude down.
I rise over a building.
I set my heading on the clearing.
I swing back for another pass.
I drop my height in stages.

lines.zh: 我在那片屋顶上方停住。
lines.en: I hold above that roof.
I hang in the air with the rotors going.
I am waiting for the wind up here.
I turn my nose slowly.
The door is open and a rope hangs.
I hold still, only pushed by wind.
I am watching the squad below.

lines.zh: 我的旋翼把草压成一片。
lines.en: My rotors press the grass flat.
I wait for the drop signal.
I hold very steady.
I point my nose at that street.
The smell of diesel never leaves.

lines.zh: 我在数地面上的变异体。
lines.en: I am counting the mutants below.
I lift a little.

lines.zh: 我听着无线电里的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the radio.
I check the fuel gauge again.
I wait for them to wave.

lines.zh: 我把机头转过来对着你。
lines.en: I turn my nose to face you.
You are on the ground and I can see you clearly.
I hover above you without moving.
You have not waved, so I do not descend.

lines.zh: 我把舱门那边的绳放低。
lines.en: I lower the rope at the door.
Are you coming aboard?

lines.zh: 我绕着你的位置转了一点。
lines.en: I turn slightly around your position.

lines.zh: 风把我的影子推到你脚下。
lines.en: My shadow slides to your feet.

lines.zh: 我看你的手有没有举起。
lines.en: I check whether your hand goes up.
I circle above you.
You need not fear the rotors.
I await your decision.

lines.zh: 机身晃了一下，我拉起来。
lines.en: The airframe lurches and I pull up.
The rotors make an odd sound.
I climb a stage and steady.
One lamp on the panel goes red.
I am re-trimming.
The shaking gets worse.
I swing clear of that area.
That goes into my log.
My rotors can still turn.
I lower my nose a little.
I do not land to eat.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我看不清。
lines.en: You hold it up and I cannot see it well.
That is for the people on the ground.
My resupply is not spent.
I rise a little.
I turn my nose away.
I do not take things from the ground.
I rock my nose once.
It is not resupply time.
I go on circling.

lines.zh: 我升高一点，把它留给地面。
lines.en: I climb a bit and leave it for the ground.
I make one circuit around it.

lines.zh: 机舱里的东西够我撑到下午。
lines.en: What is in the cabin will last me till afternoon.
I close the cabin door.

lines.zh: 你把东西放到空地上吧。
lines.en: Set it down in the open.

lines.zh: 我摇了一下机头，算是不。
lines.en: I rock my nose once, which means no.
The downdraft pushes you away.
I rise a little at once.
I do not land, so I cannot touch you.
The wind throws up all the dust.
I shift off to one side.

lines.zh: 你贴着我的起落架走太近。
lines.en: You are walking too close to my skids.
I turn slowly to avoid you.
I hold above you.
Do not stand right beneath me.
I climb half a block.
I am a machine.
That is not in the mission.
I fly my own circles in the sky.
My nose points elsewhere.
I have no such need.
I lift the airframe one notch.
I fly another way.
The rotors cover every other sound.
I do not respond.
I wait for the next signal.
I haul it up on the sling.
I bring it into the cabin.
Too heavy for my sling.
I put it on the rope's end.
I check the knot.
This is damaged; I will not take it.
I lift it and let it swing.
I hand it to the people below.
I fly on.
This one I keep.
Something is running below.
I swing my nose toward it.
I have fixed on that area.
I descend to see clearly.
It is chasing the people below.
I have radioed the ground.
I begin circling it.
Its movement is too frantic.
I cut in on its flank.
I prepare to pass low.
I circle above its head.
It runs and my nose follows.
I dive to a distance where I can see.
I pour my downdraft onto it.
It looks up at me and slows.
I stay high and behind it.
I wait for the ground team to be ready.
It tries to reach the trees.
I drop my nose a little.
That angle suits me exactly.
I strike it with my skid.

lines.zh: 我低空掠过去，风掀翻它。
lines.en: I sweep low and the downdraft flips it.

lines.zh: 我把旋翼的风压到最低。
lines.en: I drive my rotor wash straight down.
That knocked it over.

lines.zh: 它抓我的起落架，抓不住。
lines.en: It grabs my skid and cannot hold.
I press down once again.
I blow it against the wall.
It is still stirring.
I rise and adjust my angle.
I press down once more.

lines.zh: 我从云下钻出来，旋翼先响。
lines.en: I drop below the clouds with rotors sounding first.
The downdraft flattens a circle of dust.
First I steady my height.
I scan the ground once.
This place is not yet clear.

lines.zh: 我朝烟的方向转了机头。
lines.en: I turn my nose toward the smoke.
I circle over the town.
The rotor noise carries far.
I drop a stage lower.
I see the people on the ground.

lines.zh: 火烧到机腹，我把高度拉起来。
lines.en: Fire reaches my belly and I climb.

lines.zh: 我失去高度，旋翼拼命扇。
lines.en: I lose height and the rotors claw at the air.

lines.zh: 水灌进进气口，声音变了。
lines.en: Water enters the intake and the sound changes.
The blast rolls me onto my side.
Something pierces the cabin wall.

lines.zh: 术式缠住旋翼，转得发涩。
lines.en: An art binds the rotors and they grind.
The fuel gauge is near empty.
Lightning strikes the rotors and I jolt.

lines.zh: 下方没有地面，我一直掉。
lines.en: No ground below and I keep falling.
